body: Inference and training library for high-quality TTS models.
plain_description: **Create natural sounding speech from text and guide the voice’s style, pitch, and speaking rate.** Use an interactive demo or integrate speech generation into your workflow. The library also includes tools to train or fine-tune models.
technical_description: Parler-TTS is an open source Python library with inference and training code for text-to-speech models. It generates speech from text and natural language descriptions of voice characteristics, with named speakers available for more consistent voice selection. The repository documents installation, inference, training, and fine-tuning.
title: Parler-TTS
